notes.title: v0.2.4 Update is Live! 🐔⚙️
notes.content:
[h3][b]v0.2.4 Update is Live! 🐔⚙️[/b][/h3][p]Hey Chicken Fans! 🐔[/p][p]A brand new update for [b]Run Chicken Run[/b] is now live! This version brings important improvements to enhance your overall gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new in [b]v0.2.4[/b]:[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/p][p]✅ Fixed several known issues.
⚖️ Adjusted stamina balance — running is now more fair!
🔗 Updated the bug report link so you can easily share any issues with us.[/p][p]As always, your feedback is incredibly valuable. Reporting bugs helps us make the game even better — thank you for your support![/p][p]Have fun and don’t forget to keep running! 🍗💨[/p]

tags.balance_change: ⚖️ Adjusted stamina balance — running is now more fair!

tags.bug: 🔗 Updated the bug report link so you can easily share any issues with us.

notes.title: Demo Version (v0.2.3) Update is Live! 🐔🚀
notes.content: [h2]Here are the v0.2.3 release notes:[/h2][p][/p][h3]🆕 New Feature:[/h3][p]💫 We've now added a star effect on fainting chickens! Now getting stunned looks much more dramatic![/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️ Edits and Bug Fixes:[/h3][p][/p][p]🧱 Fixed wall collision bugs in some scenes.[/p][p]🏹 Fixed Crossbow ammo bug.[/p][p]🕴️ Fixed a bug that caused the character to disappear in some situations.[/p][p]🆘 Added “Unstack” feature for situations where players are stuck.[/p][p]🐞 Fixed various bugs reported by our community.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you very much to everyone who provided feedback! If you encounter any issues or have any suggestions, don't forget to share them with us.[/p][p][/p][p]Have fun playing and stay away from the frying pan! 🍳🔥Demo Version (v0.2.3) Update is Live! 🐔🚀[/p]
